In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
image schemata are a) pre- and postconceptual (or pre- and postlinguistic), b) embodied and situated, c) dynamic, and d) both universal and variable.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
image schemata are the most basic spatial patterns that are constituted in our physical interaction with the outside world.
image schemata are the basic building blocks of our mental life.
image schemata provide us with a cognitive basis for conceptualization, which in turn allows us to conceptualize and express our experience of the world, including the part whole relation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we will have to be very careful when dealing with the notion of image schema.
image schemata are not only important in their own right but also provide a useful framework to understand the nature and function of pwo relations in the language of ordinary people.
image schemata are not just a bunch of static, abstract, disembodied concepts, but are instead dynamic, embodied and grounded in experience.
